messages:
sam: Ran a handful of nsys/perfetto traces against the branch with kv-cache enabled. Seeing a big spike in time inside our kernel selector path (not the kernel itself) when batch sizes spike. NVTX coverage is sparse in that area so the timeline is noisy. attaching the trace link: https://perfetto.local/abc123 :thinking:

anya: Could be the selector doing extra allocations or string ops while deciding which kernel to pick. Two quick ideas: 1) add a coarse per-request root range (rt.req.<id>) so all child ranges are grouped, 2) add a small set of static NVTX ranges around the selector: rt.sel, rt.schedule, rt.dispatch. Keep names short to avoid dynamic allocs.

leo: Strong +1 for static short names. Also, avoid NVTX push/pop inside the inner hot loop unless gated by sampling or an env var — NVTX itself can add measurable overhead at 100k+ pushes/sec. Suggest: sample 1/200 requests for micro spans, always emit coarse spans.

maria: FWIW I bisected a perf regression to commit abc123 (kernel routing refactor). GPU total time up ~18% on our long-seq workload. Local nsys report: 
```
GPU time: 118.2s (baseline 100.1s)\nKernel selector CPU time: 12.4s -> 28.9s\nContext switches up slightly
```
If we instrument selector with fine-grain NVTX we need to ensure selector code paths don't do heap allocs when tracing is enabled.

sam: Good catch on the refactor, thanks. For instrumentation plan I'm thinking:
- always emit rt.req.<short-id> root and rt.kv.{hit|miss} coarse ranges
- emitter uses a thread-local boolean for 'tracing active' so we avoid per-push checks in hot path (check once at request start)
- fine-grain selector ranges only when TRACE_SAMPLING=1 (sample 0.5% default)
- use a fixed small-name table for selector outcomes (sel:fast, sel:fallback, sel:quant)

anya: For naming conventions, propose: 
- root: rt.req.<uid4> (4 hex chars)
- coarse: rt.kv.hit, rt.kv.miss, rt.batch.coalesce
- selector: rt.sel.<stage> (stage from set {fast,fallback,quant})
Keep everything ASCII-safe and <= 24 chars. Document this in a short DEVEX note.

leo: Also add an instrumentation-mode that flips on a compile-time constant so on Dedicated builds we can enable slightly more detail without runtime allocs. For perf CI runs we should run with sampling=off and NVTX-heavy=on to validate worst-case overhead.

maria: I'm going to run a follow-up nsys with: 
```
NSYS_CMD="nsys profile --output=out.nsys --sample=none --trace=cuda,osrt" ./run_infer_longseq
```
and a perfetto capture with the coarse + sampled micro ranges. I'll post links once uploaded.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed branch instrumentation/trace-sampling to staging at 2026-03-18T10:42Z :rocket:

sam: I'll open a small PR that adds the root + coarse ranges and the sampling gate. Will include microbench numbers (no-op tracing vs enabled) and docs for the name table. Ping me if you want to review before merge. :thumbsup:
